title: Introducing gpt-realtime and Realtime API updates
description: We’re releasing a more advanced speech-to-speech model and new API capabilities including MCP server support, image input, and SIP phone calling support.

title: Supporting nonprofit and community innovation
description: OpenAI launches a $50M People-First AI Fund to help U.S. nonprofits scale impact with AI. Applications open Sept 8–Oct 8, 2025 for grants in education, healthcare, research, and more.

title: Game On: How Modders Reimagine Classic Games With NVIDIA RTX Remix and Generative AI
description: Last week at Gamescom, NVIDIA announced the winners of the NVIDIA and ModDB RTX Remix Mod Contest, a $50,000 competition celebrating community-made projects that reimagine classic games with modern fidelity. title: Drop Into the Battle: ‘Gears of War: Reloaded’ Launches on GeForce NOW
